comparison.objective: Fit a funnel to a narrow bottle and pour beads into it.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool selection and seating, bimanual pouring, and bulk granular transfer.
comparison.success_condition: At least 22 of 24 beads settled inside the bottle for one second; lower delivery counts earn partial credit.
comparison.reason: This is the closest shared bulk-transfer primitive, but it tests funnel-assisted delivery of one material into one container. The candidate tests selective passage of media while retaining washers, controlled agitation, support reseating, and clean release.
